hero.h1: Accounting agency for companies and sole traders in Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina

scope.question: How do I start working with you?
scope.answer: Getting started is simple. Contact us for a free initial consultation — we'll learn about your business, current accounting setup, and what you need. From there we'll propose the right service package, agree on handover of any existing records, and have you fully onboarded within days. There's no long-term lock-in; we work to earn your confidence every month.

stack.question: What types of clients do you serve?
stack.answer: We work with companies of every size – from newly founded businesses and startups to established SMEs – as well as with sole traders (obrt) and associations.

enterprise.question: Do you handle tax filing and compliance?
enterprise.answer: Yes, fully. We handle every aspect of your tax obligations: preparing and filing VAT returns, corporate income tax, personal income tax and all other statutory returns required under the laws of BiH and the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina (FBiH). We also track regulatory changes and tell you as soon as a change affects your business, so you are never caught off guard.

support.question: Can you serve as our Virtual CFO?
support.answer: Absolutely. Our Virtual CFO service gives you access to senior financial expertise without the cost of a full-time hire. We provide cash flow forecasting, budget planning, financial analysis, board-ready reports, and strategic advice — attending meetings as needed. It's ideal for growing businesses that need financial leadership but aren't yet ready for a dedicated CFO.

integration.question: What accounting software do you use?
integration.answer: At the agency we primarily use **Pantheon**, but we also adapt to the systems our clients already use. We have experience with several accounting programs, including **e-line**, **Microsoft Dynamics NAV**, **InfoSoft** and similar. If you already use a particular program and have an active contract with its provider, we can also organise the work in your existing system.

industries.question: How are your services priced?
industries.answer: The price of our accounting services depends on the size of the business, the volume of documents, the number of employees and how complex the operations are. For newly founded limited liability companies (d.o.o.), prices start from 300 KM (about €153) per month; for newly founded sole traders (obrt), from 150 KM (about €77) per month. As your business grows and the workload increases, we adjust the scope of our support, and the price with it. For existing companies and sole traders switching from another accounting agency, we set the price individually after a short review of the business and its needs. Our aim is a price that is clear, fair and matched to what the business actually needs, with no hidden costs or unclear charges.

engagement.question: Do you offer education or training for in-house bookkeeping?
engagement.answer: Yes. Depending on your needs, we provide one-to-one professional support and practical training for companies and sole traders that handle part of their administration or bookkeeping in-house alongside an external accountant. This can include organising internal documents, training staff to use accounting software, explaining basic accounting processes, and helping management understand financial statements and key business indicators. Sole traders who keep their own books can also get individual consultations and practical explanations of their legal obligations and records.
